headline: VERTICES PARTNERS acts on Open Secret fundraise
sum: Immaculatebites Private Limited, dba Open Secret, has raised ₹50 crore from a fundraise led by Desai Brothers Group. VERTICES PARTNERS advised Open Secret on this fundraise.
detail: Immaculatebites Private Limited, dba Open Secret, has raised ₹50 crore from a fundraise led by Desai Brothers Group. VERTICES PARTNERS advised Open Secret on this fundraise. The transaction was led by Vishal Mehta (Partner), along with Nisha Dharod (Associate Manager). Founder and Managing Partner Vinayak Burman provided strategic inputs.
